intent.purpose: Follow what people who build with AI agents post on X, without opening X.
intent.success: A short overview of first-hand posts about agents and attention from the last day; nothing if nothing qualifies.

interests.focus: Concrete methods, tools or results from building or using AI agents and agent harnesses.
How agents keep memory, context or preferences across sessions.

excluded: Giveaways, course funnels and posts that ask for engagement.

agent_posts.scope: X posts from the last 24 hours matching the query, with at least 50 likes.

procedure.account_identity: Public search through treg; no X sign-in. Use the account key treg:public.
procedure.read_state: A search through treg changes nothing on X.
procedure.item_identity: The post link, else the vendor's post id, exactly as the treg helper returns it.
procedure.pagination: One call per surface returns one page; further pages are not requested.
procedure.retrieval: treg_source.py fetch for this surface, within the window limit.

selection.include: Posts that match a listed interest with something concrete. Give the reason for inclusion.
exclude: Threads that only link to a newsletter or video without saying what is in it.
selection.uncertain_relevance: Omit weak matches; do not fill the allowance.
selection.evidence: Summarize only the post's own text and distinguish claims from verified results.

coverage_threads.on_access_failure: Report the unavailable surface; do not fall back to a browser or another route.

body.q: ("AI agent" OR "agent harness" OR "Claude Code" OR Codex) (memory OR workflow OR "I built") since:{since_date} min_faves:50 -is:retweet
